description: About This Opportunity Purpose: The IT Product Owner (IPO) is End to End responsible for the strategy and delivery of the product based on the product roadmap, ensuring the Product delivers the expected business value, throughout the Product lifecycle. The IT Product Owner (IPO) manages the Product through the product lifecycle in alignment with the Product Line and Product Area Strategy. What Will You Do Key Responsibilities: Operational: Understand customer/end-user needs and translate requirements and strategies to meaningful demands and use cases for product development. Define and optimize product strategy and roadmap Ensuring non-functional requirements, security, and regulatory compliance of the product according to the rules, guidelines, governance, and applicable processes. Set and achieve the Product OKRs and ensure that the Product delivers the expected business value. Manage stakeholders and dependencies across organizations. Accountable for financial planning, forecasting, budget requests and actuals. Alignment with delivery Leads for competence requests and providing forecast. Ensures that both a long term (strategy) and short term (backlog) perspective is included in the product development. Guide the product team in sprint planning, prioritization and sequencing of user stories. Ensure that the Product adheres to the required approvals for Product design and development according to the rules, guidelines, governance, and processes applicable. E2E-accountability for product delivery, including operational responsibility, through the product lifecycle. Contribute to commercial discussions together with Sourcing and Suppliers (internal and external) Contribute to governance meetings with suppliers and stakeholders. Managing interactions with service providers and ensure they deliver on agreed performance levels (contractual or non-contractual) Secure that all services are priced, orderable, measurable, and supported. Responsible for coaching the product team and to ensure that the product team(s) has the right competence mix to enable successful execution. Role Specific: This role is for the Product Owner of Intelligent Service Management Platform within Product Line IT4IT. The product owner will define and drive the evolution of Service Management towards an intelligent, autonomous, and experience-centric operating model, moving beyond traditional ITSM practices through the adoption of AI, predictive insights, proactive operations, hyper automation, and next-generation service experiences. The product owner is expected to have a deep understanding of the platform used IT Service Management (Incident, Change, Problem, Request and Knowledge Management) The product owner will be responsible for driving AI-enabled and intelligent automation within ITSM — identifying where predictive analytics, chatbots/virtual agents, and generative or agentic AI capabilities can meaningfully reduce manual effort, improve resolution speed, and elevate the employee/customer experience, while ensuring adoption is measured, governed, and responsible. Champion responsible AI use — data quality (clean configuration and knowledge data as AI input), bias/accuracy monitoring, and change management for AI-assisted workflows. The product owner will be responsible for keeping abreast with industry trends in this area and be able to create a strategy and vision, to create the most effective Service Management Platform within IT. Work with stakeholders both internally (EIT and other IT organizations, Security, Sourcing) as well as externally (Vendors, industry pioneers) to find the best outcomes for Ericsson Overall E2E cost responsible for the product, as well as billing, chargeback, wherever needed Things You Will Bring Requirements: Demonstrated ability to challenge traditional ITSM approaches and define future-state service management operating models that leverage AI, automation, predictive capabilities, and digital employee experience principles. Proven track record of driving platform modernization and transformation initiatives, balancing innovation with operational stability and business value realization. Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role in IT product management, preferably in Service Management, or asset management sectors. Experience identifying and implementing AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, virtual agents, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation use cases within enterprise service management environments. Understanding of responsible AI principles, including data quality, governance, adoption measurement, risk management, and performance monitoring. Strong understanding of employee and customer experience management principles, including service adoption, user journey mapping, service health metrics, and experience-centric design. Ability to translate business challenges into scalable digital workflows and self-service capabilities that improve productivity and service satisfaction. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage platform telemetry, operational metrics, and business insights to drive product decisions and continuous improvement. Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, value realization metrics, and business outcomes. Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across IT, Security, Enterprise Architecture, Sourcing, and business leadership teams. Ability to build and execute a long-term product strategy while balancing short-term operational priorities and enterprise objectives. Strong background in managing the product lifecycle from inception to delivery. Excellent understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and project management practices. Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification. Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next. What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more. description: Who We Are At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years. What We Do The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! Role Overview Join our first Dublin product team! CarGurus is seeking a Product Data Analyst to serve as the local analytics lead for our newly established Dublin tech office. As part of one of our fastest-growing business areas, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape our international data strategy and drive growth across our global marketplaces. In this role, you will navigate complex data environments, build scalable data assets, drive site experimentation, and tackle unstructured analytics challenges in a fast-paced, two-sided marketplace. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams, you will serve as a trusted authority bridging technical insights with business strategy. We are looking for an inquisitive, self-directed analyst who demonstrates proactive problem-solving, end-to-end ownership, and clear stakeholder communication. If you are excited to dive deep into complex data to surface actionable, high-impact insights, we’d love to hear from you! What You'll Do Exploratory & Empirical Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analyses using SQL and Python across disparate data sources (e.g., website usage, subscriptions, inventory) to quantify product performance, user behavior, and market trends. Business & Metric Definition: Condense abstract or loosely defined concepts into concrete calculations and automated dashboards (via Looker, etc.) to guide daily executive decision-making. A/B Testing & Experimentation: Serve as the authority on A/B experimentation - guiding product managers and engineers on tracking requirements, sample sizes, metric selection, and statistical significance. Help improve testing tools, algorithms, and automated processes. Data Engineering & Asset Building: Partner with Data Engineering to optimize core architecture and clickstream logging. Conceive and build automated data transformations (via dbt, LookML) to streamline quick, scalable modeling bottlenecks. Strategic Partnership & Product Innovation: Participate in planning sessions to advocate for data-driven product features aligned with business strategy. Tactfully push back against flawed proposals when supported by data. Executive Communication: Translate complex quantitative findings into clear key takeaways for senior leadership, confidently answering probing, on-the-spot questions. What You'll Bring Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience in analytics or an analytics-adjacent field, focusing on complex data modeling, quantitative analysis, and applied statistics. Technical Skills: Expert fluency in SQL. Experience with statistical programming languages (Python, R, Stata, SAS) is highly desirable. Statistical Rigor: Solid understanding of core concepts (regression, significance testing, omitted variable bias, independence/dependence). Modern Tooling & GenAI: Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI to optimize workflows and utilizing agentic coding platforms such as Claude Code (preferred) or Cursor. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to present high-impact or sensitive findings to executive stakeholders. Mindset & Ownership: Proactive, self-directed mindset willing to step outside the immediate scope, challenge assumptions, and advocate for novel ideas. Strong project planning skills to build roadmaps, estimate resources, and flag cross-functional dependencies. Preferred Tools: Snowflake, Snowplow, dbt, Looker, Jira, Salesforce. The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles. Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Position Pay Range €56.000—€79.000 EUR Working at CarGurus We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. We welcome all CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

description: As Product Owner, you will own the CMS and AI backlogs and work as an embedded partner to our engineering teams, ensuring a continuous flow of clear, well-prioritised and outcome-driven work. You will play a key role in translating business objectives into deliverable product increments, balancing customer value, technical sustainability and delivery predictability. Working closely with Product Management, you will help shape and refine requirements, turning strategic objectives into well-defined epics, features, product back log and acceptance criteria. While Product Management owns product strategy and roadmap decisions, you will be responsible for ensuring teams have the clarity and context needed to deliver effectively. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working closely with engineers, challenging assumptions, managing priorities and making informed trade-offs in a complex software environment. You will contribute to the ongoing evolution of our CMS platform while helping identify and deliver practical AI-driven capabilities that create value for our customers and business. Responsibilities Own and prioritise the CMS and AI backlogs, ensuring work is transparent, appropriately sequenced and aligned with agreed product and business priorities. Translate business objectives, stakeholder needs and product initiatives into clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that enable efficient delivery by engineering teams. Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning and ongoing prioritisation activities, ensuring teams have sufficient clarity to deliver with confidence and predictability. Define and validate acceptance criteria, ensuring completed work meets agreed requirements, quality expectations and release readiness standards before delivery. Balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term platform sustainability by incorporating non-functional requirements such as performance, reliability, security and maintainability into backlog priorities. Identify and shape opportunities to leverage AI capabilities within the platform, working with Product Management and engineering teams to translate ideas into valuable, deliverable outcomes. Communicate progress, priorities, risks and trade-offs to stakeholders, using delivery metrics and evidence-based insights to support effective decision-making. Key Requirements Proven experience owning and maintaining a product backlog within an Agile software delivery environment. Demonstrated ability to translate business problems and product objectives into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria and deliverable work packages. Experience working closely with software engineering teams to prioritise work, clarify requirements and manage competing demands. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build alignment and manage expectations across technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to use delivery and product metrics to inform prioritisation, decision-making and continuous improvement. Practical understanding of software development practices and how architecture, operational concerns and technical constraints influence product decisions. Experience working with content management systems, workflow platforms or configurable enterprise software solutions. Experience defining or delivering AI-enabled product features, workflows or capabilities. Experience using AI-powered tools to improve productivity, research, analysis and delivery outcomes. Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira or similar Agile delivery tooling. Experience working within insurance, financial services or other regulated industries, with knowledge of complex business processes and compliance considerations. Who We Are DOCOsoft is a leading software and services provider to Lloyd’s of London and the broader London insurance market. Since our foundation, we have grown to become one of the leading insurance software specialists in the London Insurance Market. We are a growing team of over 110 colleagues based in Dublin, London, Tokyo, Portugal, Spain, India and Poland. Here’s What We Have To Offer DOCOsoft aspires to be a market leader in the technology sector and we are always looking for new ways to approach projects and improve how we deliver value. We hire people who bring hard work, enthusiasm and their own ideas. We Offer 25 days Annual Leave Private pension Bonus scheme Private health Life assurance Equal Opportunity Employer DOCOsoft is committed to building an inclusive and diverse team that represents a variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and do not discriminate on any legally protected grounds. If you require reasonable accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know.

description: Introduction At IBM Consulting UK FutureNow, you’ll build a career at the forefront of hybrid cloud and AI, working with leading clients across the public and private sectors. You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth. We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique. Methodologies: Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) Soft Skills Critical thinking and structured problem-solving. Clear verbal and written communication (translating tech to business and vice versa). Stakeholder management and negotiation. Active listening and facilitation. Sample Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Requirement accuracy and traceabilty (minimizing scope creep/rework). Process cycle time reduction in target workflows. Stakeholder satisfaction scores (CSAT). On-time delivery rate of UAT and specification deliverables. An additional range of Personal Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NVS) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). description: Stellenbeschreibung Du möchtest die digitale Transformation von Bund, Ländern und Kommunen aktiv mitgestalten und digitale Produkte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleiten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bei CGI entwickeln wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden moderne digitale Lösungen für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Als Product Owner (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und unseren cross-funktionalen IT-Teams und sorgst dafür, dass aus fachlichen Anforderungen erfolgreiche digitale Lösungen entstehen. Aufgaben Du verantwortest die fachliche Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte und IT-Lösungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden eine Produktvision und Roadmap. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und IT koordinierst du Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine strukturierte Kommunikation sicher. Du übernimmst die fachliche Steuerung cross-funktionaler Teams, begleitest die Umsetzung und behältst Fortschritt, Qualität und Ergebnisse im Blick. Du bereitest Workshops und Managemententscheidungen vor, moderierst agile Formate und präsentierst Produktfortschritte, Roadmaps und relevante Kennzahlen. Qualifikation Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im IT-Umfeld mit, idealerweise als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, Requirements Engineering, Backlog Management sowie der Erstellung und Priorisierung von Epics und User Stories. Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross-funktionalen IT-Teams und unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern; Kenntnisse im Public Sector sind von Vorteil. Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1). Wir bieten dir: Bei CGI stehen unsere Mitarbeiter ganz vorne: durch unseren Share Purchase Plan (Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst Du in CGI-Aktien investieren) sind unsere Mitarbeiter Teilhaber am Erfolg unseres Unternehmen, daher werden sie auch Member genannt. Als CGI Member hat man zusätzlich diese Vorteile: Bei uns findest du Kolleg*innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Dank unseres „Metro Market“-Modells kannst du meist dort arbeiten, wo du lebst. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Wir bieten verschiedene Modelle, damit du mobil sein kannst: z. B. Bahncard, Dienstfahrrad oder Firmenwagen. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir unterstützen dich, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite. Eine Vielzahl an Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

description: Il reste trois semaines avant la mise en production. La nouvelle plateforme de paiements est prête, les tests sont au vert, le métier attend le go-live et l'IT considère le sujet clos. Il ne manque qu'une signature, celle du Head of Operations, et il refuse de la donner. Son équipe perd une étape de rapprochement manuel qu'elle pratique depuis dix ans, et il ne fait pas confiance au contrôle automatisé qui la remplace. Il n'a peut-être pas complètement tort. Sur une petite partie des flux, la date de cut-off n'est pas renseignée de la même façon dans l'ancien système et dans le nouveau. Si votre premier réflexe est de chercher ce qu'il a vu et que les autres n'ont pas vu, plutôt que de chercher comment obtenir sa signature, nous aimerions échanger avec vous. Le contexte NOVA Partners recherche un / une Business Analysts pour accompagner ses clients du secteur financier au Luxembourg. Selon votre parcours et les besoins du moment, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets de transformation très différents : nouveaux outils, évolutions réglementaires, refonte de processus, migrations de systèmes. Ces projets ont souvent un point commun : ils mobilisent en même temps plusieurs équipes, le métier, les opérations, la finance, la conformité et l'IT. Ce que vous ferez vraiment Transformer des besoins métier, parfois flous ou contradictoires, en exigences fonctionnelles claires et testables. Découper les besoins en user stories avec les Product Owners, dans un cadre Agile ou plus classique selon les missions. Être le point de contact de bout en bout sur vos sujets, du premier atelier à la mise en production. Mener des analyses d'impact et rédiger des spécifications fonctionnelles. Analyser la qualité des données, comprendre l'origine des écarts et proposer des solutions durables. Préparer et piloter les tests fonctionnels, d'acceptation et de migration. Réunir autour d'une même solution des interlocuteurs qui ne parlent pas la même langue : métier, opérationnel, contrôleur, développeur. Assurer un support fonctionnel après la mise en production, le temps que tout soit stabilisé. Ce que ce poste n'est pas Ce n'est pas un rôle de prise de notes ni de transmission de tickets. Un bon BA ne se contente pas de retranscrire ce qu'on lui demande : il comprend pourquoi on le demande, repère ce que personne n'a formulé et sait dire non, arguments à l'appui, quand une solution ne tient pas. Obtenir l'adhésion compte plus que de faire valider un document. Ce qui fera la différence Une expérience confirmée de Business Analyst dans le secteur financier : banque, fonds d'investissement, assurance ou services financiers. La capacité à comprendre rapidement un nouveau métier et ses processus de bout en bout. Une aisance réelle avec la donnée : SQL, analyses de qualité, rapprochements. La connaissance des méthodes Agile, et le recul nécessaire pour les adapter plutôt que les appliquer à la lettre. La maîtrise des outils habituels du BA (Jira, Confluence, modélisation de processus), appréciée. Une communication claire et structurée, en anglais comme en français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Pourquoi ce poste plutôt qu'un autre Parce que vous ne serez pas cantonné(e) à un seul sujet : chaque mission est l'occasion de découvrir un nouveau métier, de nouvelles équipes et de nouveaux enjeux. Parce que le cadre du conseil vous place là où un bon BA fait vraiment la différence. Et parce que chez NOVA Partners, nous plaçons des profils que nous connaissons, dans des missions que nous comprenons. Pour candidater Envoyez-nous votre CV. Si vous le souhaitez, ajoutez deux lignes : le stakeholder le plus difficile que vous ayez eu à convaincre, et ce qui l'a finalement fait changer d'avis. C'est souvent la partie que nous lisons en premier.
title: Business Analyst

description: About the Role: As part of the Group Food Safety & Quality function, the Casa Ferrero Sensory Specialist & Data Analyst plays a key role in driving sensory excellence and data-driven decision making. Main Responsibilities: You will support the planning, organization, execution, and interpretation of sensory evaluation activities , ensuring the generation of reliable insights to support product quality. Acting as a sensory science and analytics partner, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of robust sensory programs. Moreover, you will coordinate sensory activities , including sample management, preparation of sensory sessions, laboratory organization, and panel support, ensuring full alignment with Ferrero sensory methodologies, standards, and procedures. Through the application of statistical analysis, you will support the identification of risks, deviations, and opportunities . You will also provide sensory and analytical support during quality investigations, product assessments, and ad hoc evaluations , contributing to root cause investigations, risk assessment activities, and evidence-based decision making. In addition, you will actively support the development of a strong sensory culture within Headquarters by contributing to training programs, workshops, and capability-building initiatives . You will promote best practices in sensory science, facilitate knowledge sharing, and help increase awareness of the value of sensory evaluation and data-driven quality management throughout the organization. You will also maintain an efficient and well-organized sensory laboratory environment , ensuring proper sample storage, traceability, inventory management, and availability of materials required for sensory activities. About You: You bring a Master’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, or a related field, together with 1-3 years of professional experience . You are eager to grow your expertise and contribute to a role where sensory science and quality come together. You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English . You know how to work with statistical analysis tools and standard digital applications , using data to support informed decisions and meaningful outcomes. You thrive when balancing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. At the same time, you collaborate effectively with others and contribute positively to shared goals and your team’s mission. What We Offer: Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here. About Ferrero: Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com. DE&I at Ferrero: Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. description: Zie jij commerciële kansen én kun je ze zelf bouwen? Til onze webshop én de resultaten naar een hoger niveau. Impact van de functie Met meer dan 3 miljoen maandelijks actieve gebruikers, een sterk merk en steeds meer producten en proposities ligt er een enorme commerciële kans in onze webshop. Als E-commerce Manager ben jij degene die ervoor zorgt dat we die kans benutten. Je bent commercieel eigenaar van onze webshop en stuurt op omzet, conversie, gemiddelde orderwaarde en marge. Je analyseert waar bezoekers afhaken, ziet waar we omzet laten liggen en bepaalt welke verbeteringen de meeste impact hebben. Maar bij Flitsmeister blijft het niet bij plannen maken. Dankzij jouw technische achtergrond kun je veel van je ideeën ook zelf realiseren. Een nieuwe landingspagina, productcomponent, bundel, checkoutverbetering of experiment? Je kunt het zelf bouwen, testen en live zetten. Grote impact, klein team en geen eindeloze vergaderingen. Je krijgt de vrijheid om kansen te zien, keuzes te maken en de webshop stap voor stap beter te maken. Jouw team Je werkt op het snijvlak van commercie, marketing en development. Je bent onderdeel van het Marketingteam en schakelt veel met onze marketeers, designers, developers en Sales & Supply om commerciële kansen te vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen in de webshop. Voor technische kennisdeling en afstemming sluit je aan bij Chapter Frontend. We zijn een klein team met korte lijnen, waardoor je snel kunt schakelen. Heb je een goed idee? Dan hoef je niet langs vijf lagen voordat je ermee aan de slag kunt. Dit ga je doen Jij pakt ownership over onze webshop: van commerciële performance tot de techniek waarmee we die performance verbeteren. Concreet Ga Je Sturen op omzet, conversie, gemiddelde orderwaarde en marge en deze KPI's continu verbeteren. De winkelervaring technisch doorontwikkelen en onderhouden: van productpagina en winkelwagen tot checkout en orderflows. Met React, TypeScript en Next.js bouw je zelf nieuwe features en verbeteringen en breng je die van idee naar live. Je eigen e-commerce roadmap bepalen op basis van klantbehoefte, data, commerciële impact en benodigde inspanning. De volledige webshopfunnel analyseren en ontdekken waar bezoekers afhaken en waar commerciële kansen liggen. Hypotheses opstellen, A/B-tests en andere experimenten uitvoeren en succesvolle verbeteringen doorvoeren. Productpagina's, merchandising, bundels, upsell, cross-sell, pricing en promoties optimaliseren. Campagnes, proposities en productintroducties vertalen naar landingspagina's, acties en andere shopmechanismen. Acquisitie verbinden aan e-commerce en sturen op wat verkeer daadwerkelijk oplevert, waaronder conversie, CAC en ROAS. Kansen benutten rondom abandoned cart, browse abandonment en post-purchase. E-commerce analytics en rapportages zo inrichten dat data leidt tot concrete acties. SEO en commerciële content inzetten om zowel vindbaarheid als conversie te verbeteren. Nieuwe verkoopkanalen onderzoeken, zoals social commerce, marketplaces en affiliates. Samen met Sales & Supply kijken naar beschikbaarheid, fulfilment, verzendkosten en de impact daarvan op conversie en marge. Je past bij ons We zoeken dus niet alleen een goede developer en ook niet alleen een e-commerce specialist. We zoeken iemand die beide werelden bij elkaar brengt. Je Herkent Jezelf Hierin Je hebt ruime ervaring met e-commerce en weet hoe je een webshop commercieel laat groeien. Je bent analytisch sterk en gewend beslissingen te nemen op basis van data. CRO, experimenteren en A/B-testen zijn voor jou een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van e-commerce. Je begrijpt hoe acquisitie, conversie, klantwaarde en retentie met elkaar samenhangen. Je hebt sterke hands-on ervaring met React, TypeScript en Next.js en vindt het leuk om zelf te blijven bouwen. Je kunt designs en commerciële ideeën vertalen naar gebruiksvriendelijke shop-features en herbruikbare UI-componenten binnen ons eigen design system. Je werkt makkelijk samen met backend developers en bent comfortabel met API's, data en shoplogica. Je hebt affiniteit met SEO, analytics en e-commerceplatforms. Ervaring met Tailwind CSS, Vue 3, Google Tag Manager, i18n of platforms als Magento, Shopify of Medusa is mooi meegenomen. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. En misschien nog belangrijker: je wacht niet totdat iemand met een briefing naar je toe komt. Je ziet zelf waar een kans ligt, onderbouwt die met data en pakt het eigenaarschap om er iets mee te doen. Dat doe je vanuit zowel commercieel als technisch oogpunt. Wat je van ons kunt verwachten Grote impact betekent bij ons niet automatisch een grote organisatie. Je werkt aan producten die miljoenen mensen gebruiken, maar in een hechte club waar je elkaar kent en snel kunt schakelen. Daar Krijg Je Onder Andere Voor Terug Een salaris tussen €3.800 en €5.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Binnen deze salarisschaal is er perspectief om verder te groeien. Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week. Vakantiegeld en een vaste 13e maand. Een goede pensioenregeling. Internet- en reiskostenvergoeding. Een MacBook met accessoires. Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken. Dagelijks lunch, snacks, fruit, goede koffie en frisdrank op kantoor. Borrel, tafeltennis, sport en andere activiteiten met collega's. Veel vrijheid om te experimenteren, te bouwen en zelf keuzes te maken. Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en mee te groeien terwijl Flitsmeister verder groeit. Ons kantoor in Veenendaal is daarbij onze thuisbasis: de plek waar we elkaar ontmoeten, samenwerken en ideeën uitwisselen. Klaar om impact te maken Wil jij niet alleen bedenken hoe een webshop beter kan presteren, maar het ook zelf kunnen bouwen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer en bouw mee aan de volgende fase van e-commerce bij Flitsmeister!

description: Product Analyst Immediately available Amsterdam / Remote Are you a data expert who loves turning user behavior into product decisions? Join the Product Analytics team of a leading online company, where you help millions of buyers and sellers trust each other and find what they need faster. Analysts here work inside multidisciplinary product teams alongside product managers, UX designers, and developers. You'll formulate the right questions and answer them with data analysis, machine learning, modeling, and continuous experimentation. 🎯 What you'll do ✅ Uncover user and customer insights through descriptive and diagnostic analysis ✅ Identify and interpret trends and patterns, and turn them into reports and dashboards that support business decisions and strategic planning ✅ Apply advanced analytics to improve predictive capability and user segmentation ✅ Lead A/B testing and other experiments, applying the scientific method and performing deep-dive analyses ✅ Define tagging plans and measure the impact of the site, campaigns, and user behavior together with Product, UX, and Marketing ✅ Strengthen the data-driven culture within the product teams 🛠️ Tech stack ✅ SQL and large datasets ✅ Python or R ✅ A/B testing, experimentation, and statistical and causal analysis ✅ Digital analytics and data visualization (dashboards) This is you ✅ 5+ years of experience in analytics or data science ✅ Experience working closely with multidisciplinary product teams in a digital environment (e-commerce or similar is a plus) ✅ Strong SQL skills and experience with large datasets ✅ Knowledge of Python or R ✅ Hands-on experience with A/B testing and a solid understanding of statistical and causal analysis ✅ Preferably a degree in statistics, computer science, econometrics, economics, or a related quantitative field ✅ Curious about user behavior, with initiative and drive, and energized by the interplay of data, product, and tech ✅ Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain complex findings clearly and concisely Interested? We'd love to meet you! Please get in touch with Samantha Alves Goncalves at sgoncalves@xccelerated.io or by phone at 0613889770.

description: About Advance Intelligence Group Headquartered in Singapore, Advance Intelligence Group a Series D-backed Tech Unicorn valued at US$2 billion , and also one of the largest independent technology startups based in Singapore. Founded in 2016, the Group has over 2000+ employees and has presence across South and Southeast Asia, Latin America and Greater China serving 700+ enterprise clients, 150,000+ merchants and 30 million+ consumers. The Group is backed by top tier investors SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Warburg Pincus, Northstar, Vision Plus Capital, Gaorong Capital, Pavilion Capital, GSR Ventures and Singapore-based global investor EDBI. Atome Financial offers consumers greater financial access through technology with its suite of products including Atome, a leading "buy now pay later" brand, and digital lending services such as Kredit Pintar in Indonesia. Ginee is a leading e-commerce merchant services technology platform serving numerous markets in Southeast Asia; providing comprehensive digital solutions for e-commerce, retail, brand and enterprise customers. We are united by a shared vision and purpose: to Advance with Intelligence for a Better Life--for our customers, colleagues and communities. Our culture is built on values that are core to who we are and what we stand for: We foster an INNOVATION mindset We achieve results with EFFICIENCY and excellence We take pride in the QUALITY of our work We uphold INTEGRITY in all we do We embrace COLLABORATION to work across business lines and borders About The Role We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the planning and design of our AI Model Intelligent Routing Gateway product. You will be responsible for building a standardized enterprise platform that enables unified access to multiple AI models, while improving routing efficiency, governance, cost optimization, security, compliance, and commercialization capabilities. This role sits at the core of our AI platform strategy, focusing on turning complex enterprise and model-level requirements into scalable, reusable product capabilities that support long-term business growth. You Will Own the end-to-end product planning, design, versioning, and iteration of the AI Model Intelligent Routing Gateway product. Design and continuously improve core capabilities, including multi-model integration, intelligent routing, traffic scheduling, rate limiting, circuit breaking, failover, and fallback/degradation mechanisms. Understand enterprise customer needs across model management, invocation stability, cost control, security governance, and operational efficiency, and translate them into standardized platform capabilities. Drive the design of supporting platform capabilities, including tenant architecture, permission management, API key management, quota control, billing and invoicing, auditing, and analytics. Collaborate closely with R&D, architecture, algorithm, testing, pre-sales, sales, and customer success teams to ensure end-to-end product delivery from solution design to launch. Support key customer projects, solution packaging, tender and bidding responses, and market feedback analysis to continuously improve product competitiveness. What You Need To Succeed Bachelor's degree or above. 3+ years of experience as a B2B (To B) Product Manager. Experience in platform products such as AI platforms, API gateways, cloud platforms, service governance, or multi-tenant SaaS/PaaS products. Strong understanding of the large-model application ecosystem, including multi-model integration, invocation workflows, routing strategies, and key metrics such as cost, latency, performance, and quality. Strong product thinking in planning, requirement abstraction, documentation, and execution, with the ability to independently drive products from concept to implementation. Ability to abstract customized enterprise customer needs into standardized, platform-based product capabilities. Basic understanding of enterprise-grade product requirements, including stability, security, permissions, auditing, billing, and data governance. Strong cross-functional collaboration, customer communication, and data analysis skills.

description: What You Can Expect Workvivo is investing in a scaled account based marketing motion and is seeking someone to own it end to end. This role connects marketing, SDR, and sales teams. The position involves transforming account insights into actionable strategies by identifying accounts, building data foundations, and collaborating with SDR and AE teams. It requires expertise in guiding SDR and AE leaders on account prioritization. Candidates with experience managing tiered strategies and distinguishing between activity and pipeline will thrive in this role. The focus is on delivering impactful and timely initiatives that drive success across targeted accounts. About The Team This role is part of the Global Field and Strategic Events team within Growth and Demand Generation. It focuses on account-based marketing strategies. Responsibilities include executing personalized programs for top US accounts, targeted programs for account clusters, and broader initiatives combining events, digital, and field efforts. The target audience includes enterprise leaders such as CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications professionals. The role emphasizes creating impactful marketing motions to engage key stakeholders and scale efforts effectively across various segments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and priorities. Responsibilities Managing Workvivo’s tiered ABM motion involves 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account clusters, and 1:many for programmatic engagement at scale. Building and maintaining the account scoring and intent framework determines the appropriate tier placement and timing for account transitions. Designing and managing multi-channel campaigns that integrate outbound, paid, and content efforts, ensuring accounts experience a unified approach rather than fragmented interactions. Collaborating directly with SDR leaders to convert account priorities into structured sequencing, cadence, and outreach strategies. Partnering directly with AE teams on account planning, defining shared transfer criteria, and ensuring joint accountability for pipeline within target accounts. Managing the enrichment and intent data stack while overseeing associated vendor relationships. Reporting on ABM performance involves using account-level metrics like engagement, penetration, and pipeline influenced, rather than focusing solely on activity volume. Collaborating with Marketing Ops and RevOps ensures accurate account and contact data, as scaled processes quickly fail when the information is incorrect. Adapting the motion by region, recognizing that EMEA, LATAM, and APJ will not run the same play at the same pace. What We’re Looking For Demonstrate experience using an intent or account scoring platform such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar within a production environment. Demonstrate experience with enrichment and data orchestration tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or similar) and how to connect them cleanly into a CRM. Demonstrate proficiency in Salesforce and a sequencing tool like Outreach, including understanding how account and contact data transfers between platforms. Demonstrate over six years of experience developing and managing tiered account-based marketing strategies effectively. Direct experience as an SDR or working alongside SDR and AE teams on the same accounts, with shared ownership of outcomes. Comfort presenting account level and pipeline metrics to stakeholders in clear, accessible language. Operate effectively across various regions or markets. Develop an ABM function from an initial or unstructured phase into a well-organized, tiered approach. Possess experience in SaaS or B2B technology within an organization utilizing a distributed or hybrid sales structure. Minimum Salary Range or On Target Earnings: €59,700.00 Maximum €95,500.00 In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value. Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations. Ways of Working Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting. Benefits As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information. About Us Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars. We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment. Our Commitment At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step. description: Every employee at Al Rostamani Group plays a role in making a real difference to the business and our customers. We care for our employees by offering them meaningful and purposeful work and an opportunity to grow, learn, contribute and succeed. Today, the Al Rostamani Group has come a long way since its birth in 1957. Our group has grown steadfastly with the guiding principles of Commitment, Care & Vision, alongside a strong sense of active involvement in the community. We are a well-diversified group, with a key presence in industries such as General Trading, Automobiles and Heavy Equipment, Travel, Foreign Exchange, Financial Services, Property Management, Construction, Infrastructure Development and Information Technology Services. Our Group employs approximately 2000 people from 41 different nationalities, which contributes to our multicultural and multi-national environment. Al Rostamani Trading Company is the sole authorized distributor of Suzuki and Citroën across the UAE with Sales, Service and Parts outlets able to serve its customers throughout the country. Job Purpose The Business Analyst in the After Sales Department is responsible for analysing after sales data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to drive business growth. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance after sales performance, forecast trends, and support decision-making. Job Responsibilities Analyze after sales data ( Service and Spare parts) to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for growth. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to monitor after sales performance. Act as window person for OEM for any forecast or actual reports or adhoc data needed. Liaise with Group IT and MIS on optimizing the reporting or system outputs for after sales data. Create accurate after sales forecasts based on historical data, market conditions, and industry trends for both services and parts verticals. Collaborate with Service manager, parts manager and workshop leads to develop data-driven sales plans and targets. Identify potential risks and opportunities to optimize after sales strategies. Work with the CRM team to enhance the use of customer data in after sales strategies. Act as a liaison between the after sales team and other departments, including marketing, finance, and Sales Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders. Track the achievement of after sales KPIs and targets, providing actionable insights for underperforming areas. Monitor branch performance and provide benchmarks against industry standards. Job Requirements Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field. Advanced degree or certifications in Business Analysis, Data Science, or Sales Analytics are a plus. Experience 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in the automotive or retail sector. Proven experience in sales data analysis, forecasting, and process improvement. At Al Rostamani Group, we seek talented people who work hard to achieve great things. We consider not only your skills and experience, but also your passion for the role, your desire to learn and how well you align with our core values of care, commitment and vision. If this position represents an opportunity you wish to pursue, we invite you to apply.

description: Job Purpose At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through, our global hub in Dubai; and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers ‘Fly Better’. Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting-edge information and technology team as a Technical Product Owner - Airport Operations (Emiratisation). Join our Technical Product Management team, where we build effective technology products and services that our customers love. We offer a mix of B2B and B2C products and services in domains such as Digital, Airline and Airport Operations, Group Services, and Commercial. Our goal is to continuously evolve our products, enriching them with features that focus on delivering value to our customers and users. If you are passionate about creating impactful technology products and ensuring their success, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the innovation and excellence at Emirates Group. Technical Product Owners (TPO) are the front door to multiple product engineering teams, owning the backlogs of work spread across feature, function, non-functional (NFR), BAU, Technical Debt, spikes, and ceremonies. Leading and empowering their teams, the TPO acts as a voice of the customer, partnering with business counterparts to lead the lifecycle for designated technology products and the underlying applications in their domain. They are accountable for enabling the business to achieve their objectives & strategic outcomes from concept through to operations. In This Role, You Will Be Responsible for the story content, acceptance criteria definition, and end story "sign off" across team backlogs, ensuring prepared on time for future PIs, refined frequently with the entire team, and prioritised accordingly in alignment with other team backlogs. Ensures Technical Debt and Non-functional requirements are captured, refined, and prioritised across all sprints. Captures additional BAU, Ceremony, and Spike activities, and incorporates them into team backlogs, within the boundaries of available capacity. Prepare contribution to PI demo, in conjunction with other applicable Product Owners. Maintain the quality and integrity of features within their technical and team boundaries, ensuring identification and contribution of risks and dependencies back to the Product Portfolio backlog. Attends and contributes to key Product Management meetings, in particular PI Planning. Defines metrics to measure the success and performance of prioritised work, ensuring any further. BAU iterations can be proposed and prioritised accordingly within the boundaries of available capacity. Participates in establishing and growing a community of Product Owners, building an identity for the role, focusing on collaboration, and identifying opportunities for improvement and growth. Contribute to the Product Management Communities and their continual evolution to help drive efficient practices and empowered teams. Working with your team(s) to identify and capture team-driven innovation ideas, consolidating across peer groups for playback up to the TPM (Technical Product Manager) community. Qualification To Be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements: Degree or honours (12+3 or equivalent). 5+ years of experience in Information Technology (Operations Research, Marketing Science, Information Systems, e-Commerce, or a combination of industry certification and 5+ years of relevant experience). Global Product (CSPO/SAFe/PSPO) trained and certified. Knowledge/Skills 2+ years of practical experience working as a Product Owner/Manager, in a 'team-facing' capacity, with a proven record of driving discernible change and delivery at pace. Whilst not essential, some experience of working within a Scaled Agile framework, across multiple initiatives and circa 50+ teams. Demonstrated technical or domain expertise, utilising a depth and breadth of knowledge and practical experience within the specific domain or technical area. Stays up to date with regulatory and other changes in the technical area, and understands how they apply to the Emirates group. Well-versed with the tools for the Product Management aspects of software delivery. Strong and concise communicator at peer, line, and stakeholder levels. Builds strong relationships with peers and team members. Appetite for building and identifying value, with a customer centric mind-set. Data and KPIs commonly used in airline and ground handling industry. Proven Business Analysis experience to support process mapping and solutions Must have a good understanding of Airport Operations and Ground Handling systems as well as business relevant processes. Leadership role: Yes Salary & benefits Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers.
